Collector Kavitha urged fishermen in Thiruvallur district to register their personal details, and the district team should oversee community outreach.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a ₹2,000 crore allocation to implement the Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students, which the portfolio team must oversee.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
Public procurement scrutiny arose over claims that government libraries purchased AI-generated books with fictitious authors, which the portfolio team should review.
The Periyar Arivulagam book procurement controversy escalated as political parties exchanged blame and the government formed an inspection panel.
Political debate intensified over allegations of AI-generated books being procured in libraries, and the office should monitor political developments.
